title: PII detection capability contract
summary: What the redibis PII engines detect in CSV files (cell values, column names and context), through edge rules, and in free text through the Text Gateway — each with an example that is verified against the engine — and what they do not detect. It is the reference the technology and privacy/legal teams agree on. A new type is added only through the change request below.

outcomes.detected: The column or text span is confirmed as this PII type and appears in the contract / scan result.
outcomes.evidence_only: The pattern matches, but the evidence is not strong enough to confirm; the column is listed as a candidate for a person to review.
outcomes.not_detected: The engine does not report it. Listed on purpose so that nobody relies on it.
outcomes.not_verified: Needs an optional model (NER or LLM) that is not installed where the verification ran.

engines.name: Regex catalogue
engines.role: Patterns for each PII type, per script (Latin / Arabic), for single values (columns) and for free text.

engines.name: Validators
engines.role: Checksums and structure checks (Luhn, national-ID birth date and governorate, IBAN mod-97, …) that confirm a match.

engines.name: Column context
engines.role: Column-name tokens (English and Arabic) that confirm or disambiguate a pattern — e.g. nine digits are a tax ID only under a tax column.

engines.name: Phone engine
engines.role: Numbering-plan checks for mobile and landline numbers.

engines.name: Edge rules
engines.role: Declarative when → then rules of the active policy pack (telecom by default) that correct a verdict from column semantics.

engines.name: NER model (optional)
engines.role: Names, places and organisations inside free text; needs a model to be installed.

engines.name: LLM refinement (optional)
engines.role: Second opinion on uncertain columns and spans; off by default.

engines.name: Text Gateway
engines.role: Scans free text (tickets, notes, messages) and returns each PII span with its position; the same engines as above.

change_process.summary: Legal asks, technology implements, the contract proves it.
steps: Privacy/legal files a request with the template below: the PII type, why it is personal data, the countries it applies to, where it appears (CSV columns, free text, both), at least three real-looking examples that must be detected and two that must not.
Technology adds the pattern, validator or edge rule, and adds the examples to this contract as cases.
Every case is verified automatically on each change (pytest). A case that the engine does not satisfy blocks the release.
A new version of this document is generated from the Reports page (or `redibis pii capabilities report`) and shared with legal.

entities.title: Phone number
entities.description: Mobile and landline numbers: Egypt (national, +20, 0020, landlines), Saudi Arabia, UAE, and any number written in international E.164 form. Arabic-Indic digits are normalised first.

cases.title: Mobile number in an English sentence

entities.title: E-mail address
entities.description: E-mail addresses, and InstaPay payment handles (name@instapay), which identify a person the same way.

cases.title: E-mail in text
cases.text: Send the contract to mona.adel@example.com please.

entities.title: Egyptian national ID (14 digits)
entities.description: The 14-digit Egyptian national ID. The engine checks century, birth date, governorate and check digit, so random 14-digit numbers are not taken for IDs.

entities.title: Other national IDs (KSA, UAE, Jordan, Morocco)
entities.description: National IDs of other countries: Saudi national ID / Iqama and UAE Emirates ID (checksum-validated), Jordanian national number and Moroccan CIN (shape only).

cases.title: Jordanian national number
cases.note: Evidence only: the 10-digit pattern matches, but it has no checksum, so the column is listed as a NATIONAL_ID candidate for review rather than confirmed.

entities.title: Passport number
entities.description: Passport numbers in the Egyptian format: one letter followed by eight digits.

cases.title: Passport in text
cases.text: Traveller passport A12345678 expires next year.

entities.title: Egyptian tax registration number
entities.description: Egyptian tax registration numbers (nine digits, with or without dashes). Nine digits are common, so the column name must say tax / TIN.

entities.title: Egyptian vehicle plate
entities.description: Egyptian vehicle plates in Arabic or Latin letters followed by up to four digits.

entities.title: Payment card number
entities.description: Payment card numbers — Visa, Mastercard, Meeza, with or without spaces — accepted only when the Luhn checksum is valid; CVV codes when labelled.

entities.title: IBAN (bank account)
entities.description: International bank account numbers, validated with the ISO 13616 mod-97 checksum and the country's length.

entities.title: SWIFT / BIC code (Egypt)
entities.description: SWIFT / BIC codes of Egyptian banks.

entities.title: IP address
entities.description: IPv4 (public and private) and IPv6 addresses.

entities.title: MAC address
entities.description: Network hardware (MAC) addresses; broadcast and multicast addresses are rejected.

entities.title: Device IMEI
entities.description: Device IMEI numbers (Luhn-validated), with or without dashes.

cases.title: IMEI in text

entities.title: Subscriber IMSI
entities.description: Subscriber IMSI numbers of Egyptian networks (MCC 602).

entities.title: SIM card number (ICCID)
entities.description: SIM card serial numbers (ICCID, Luhn-validated).

entities.title: Date of birth
entities.description: Dates of birth (YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY) when the column is named as a birth date.

entities.title: Gender
entities.description: Gender codes (M / F / Male / Female / X / Other / Unknown) in a gender or sex column.

entities.title: Person name
entities.description: Person names in name columns, in Latin or Arabic script. Names inside free text need an NER model.

entities.title: Location (GPS, postcode, address)
entities.description: GPS coordinates (pairs, latitude with its longitude, WKT points, degrees-minutes-seconds), street addresses with address keywords in text, and — as review candidates — Egyptian postcodes.

entities.title: API keys / credentials

text_gateway.title: Text Gateway: several identifiers in one text
text_gateway.description: Free text is scanned span by span; every PII type that has a free-text pattern is found in the same pass. Per-type text examples are in the sections above.

cases.title: Several identifiers in one sentence
cases.text: Ahmed (01012345678, ahmed@example.com) paid with IBAN EG670002000100000001234567890 from 196.219.34.12.

edge_rules.title: Edge rules (telecom policy pack)
edge_rules.description: Edge rules correct a verdict from column semantics — the column name, the detected type, checksum results — never from individual values. Each rule's id is recorded in the scan's decision path.

not_supported.description: Listed so that nobody relies on them. Each can be requested through the change process.
